description_en: Creates a circuit breaking rule by calling the CreateDegradeRule operation
description_zh: 调用CreateDegradeRule接口创建降级规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi create-degrade-rule --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --resource handleService --strategy 0 --threshold 0.6 --recovery-timeout-ms 5000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDegradeRule

parameters.help_en: The AHAS namespace. Default value: default. You can create different namespaces in the console for logically isolated environments
parameters.help_zh: AHAS命名空间，默认为default，可以在控制台上创建不同namespace用于逻辑隔离
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The application name (do not use Chinese characters). If the application is an Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the App ID on the Basic Information tab of the application details page in the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名（避免中文命名），若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台具体应用的基本信息页签中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the REST or RPC interface. The name must conform to the REST or RPC interface format specification
parameters.help_zh: REST或RPC接口名，需符合REST或RPC接口格式规范
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The threshold type, which specifies the circuit breaking strategy. Valid values:
0: slow call ratio.
1: exception ratio
parameters.help_zh: 阈值类型，即降级的策略，取值为0时表示按慢调用比例降级，取值为1时表示按异常比例降级
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The circuit breaking threshold corresponding to the threshold type. Circuit breaking is triggered for the interface when this value is exceeded
parameters.help_zh: 阈值类型所对应的降级阈值，超过该值时会触发接口的降级
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The circuit breaking duration. During this period, all requests to the interface fail immediately. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 熔断时长。在该时间段内，该接口的请求都会快速失败，单位毫秒
parameters.name: recovery_timeout_ms

parameters.help_en: The statistical window duration. Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 统计窗口时长，单位毫秒。默认值为1000
parameters.name: stat_duration_ms

parameters.help_en: The slow call response time (RT). A request is counted as a slow call if its response time exceeds this value. This parameter is required when the threshold type is set to slow call ratio
parameters.help_zh: 慢调用RT。请求的响应时间超过该值时统计为慢调用。阈值类型为“慢调用比例”时需设置该字段
parameters.name: slow_rt_ms

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of requests required to trigger circuit breaking. If the number of requests in the current statistical window is less than this value, the rule is not triggered even if the circuit breaking condition is met. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 触发熔断的最小请求数目，若当前统计窗口请求数小于此值，即使达到熔断条件规则也不会触发。默认值为5
parameters.name: min_request_amount

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of requests allowed per step during circuit breaking recovery. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 熔断恢复每步最小通过数目，默认值为5
parameters.name: half_open_base_amount_per_step

parameters.help_en: The number of steps in the circuit breaking recovery phase. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 熔断恢复阶段数，默认值为1
parameters.name: half_open_recovery_step_num

AppName.description_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, AppName is the App ID in EDAS. You can view the App ID on the Basic Information tab of the application details page in the EDAS console
AppName.description_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“具体应用>基本信息页签”中查看对应的ID

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled

HalfOpenBaseAmountPerStep.description_en: The minimum number of requests allowed per step during circuit breaking recovery. Default value: 5
HalfOpenBaseAmountPerStep.description_zh: 熔断恢复每步最小通过数目，默认值为5

HalfOpenRecoveryStepNum.description_en: The number of steps in the circuit breaking recovery phase

MinRequestAmount.description_en: The minimum number of requests required to trigger circuit breaking
MinRequestAmount.description_zh: 触发熔断的最小请求数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
